items.text: Tsinzibulo tsiaLawi
Abaana baLawi; mbu Gerishomu, Kohatsi, naMerari.
Nabaana baKohatsi; mbu Amuramu, Izihari, Heberoni, naUzieli.
Nabaana baAmuramu; mbu Haruni, naMusa, naMiriamu. Nabaana baHaruni; mbu Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari, naItsamari.
Eleazari yeebula Finehasi, Finehasi niyeebula Abishua,
Abishua niyeebula Buki, Buki niyeebula Uzi,
Uzi niyeebula Zerahia, Zerahia niyeebula Merayotsi,
Merayotsi niyeebula Amaria, Amaria niyeebula Ahitubu,
Ahitubu niyeebula Zadoki, Zakoki niyeebula Ahimaazi,
Ahimaazi niyeebula Azaria, Azaria niyeebula Yohanani,
Yohanani niyeebula Azaria; ne niye owakholanga akobukuhani munzu eya Sulemani yoombakha eYerusalemu.
Ne Azaria niyeebula Amaria, Amaria niyeebula Ahitubu,
Ahitubu niyeebula Zadoki, Zadoki niyeebula Shalamu,
Shalumu niyeebula Hilikia, Hilikia niyeebula Azaria,
Azaria niyeebula Seraya, Seraya niyeebula Yehozadaki;
naye Yehozadaki yaatisibwa olwa OMWAMI yaatisia Yuda naYerusalemu mushialo khulwa omukhono kwaNebukadineza.
Abaana baLawi; mbu Gerishomu, Kohatsi, naMerari.
Nameera kabaana baGerishomu ngakano; mbu Libini naShimei.
Ne abaana baKohatsi bali Amuramu, Izihari, Heberoni, naUzieli.
Abaana baMerari; mbu Mali naMushi. Ne tsinzu tsiabaLawi nzietsino, ebilibwa biabwe shinga olwa bili; mbu
khuGerishomu; Libini omwanawe; naYahatsi waLibini; Zima waYahatsi;
Yoa waZima; Ido waYoa; Zera waIdo; Yeatserai waZera.
Abaana baKohatsi; mbu Aminadabu omwanawe; Kora omwana waAminadabu; Asiri waKora;
Elikana waAsiri; Ebiasafu waElikana; Asiri waEbiasafu;
Tahatsi waAsiri; Urieli waTahatsi; Uzia waUrieli; Shauli waUzia.
Nabaana baElikana; mbu Amasai nende Ahimotsi,
Elikana omwanawe naZofai omwanawe, naNahatsi omwana waZofai;
Eliabu waNahatsi; Yerohamu waEliabu; Elikana waYerohamu.
Nabaana baSamweli; mbu omwanawe owambeli Yoeli, nowakhabili Abiya.
Abaana baMerari; mbu Mali, naLibini omwanawe, naShimei omwana waLibini; Uza waShimei;
Shimea waUza; Hagia waShimea; Asaya waHagia.
Abeembi aba Daudi yarako muHekalu
Ne bano nibo aba Daudi yaraho okhusinjilila obukhalabani bwobwimbi munzu yOMWAMI, olwa lisanduku liOMWAMI liali nilimalile okhunyoolelwamwo obuhuluushilo.

Nabo nibakhalabanila munyimbo imbeli weshimenyo shieliheema liokhwakaana, okhuula olwa Sulemani yali niyoombashile inzu yOMWAMI eYerusalemu; nibakhola obukhalabani bwabwe, obwayi bwabwe shinga olwa bwali.
Kho abakhalabana bario, halala nabaana babwe, mbabano; mbu khubaana babaKohatsi, Hemani omwimbi, waYoeli, waSamweli,
waElikana, waYerohamu, waElieli, waToa,
waZufi, waElikana, waMahatsi, waAmasai,
waElikana, waYoeli, waAzaria, waZefania,
waTahatsi, waAsiri, waEbiasafu, waKora,
waIzihari, waKohatsi, waLawi, waIsiraeli.
Nende Asafu omwana wabwe, owasinjilanga khumukhonokwe musaatsa, niye Asafu waBerekhia, waShimea,
waMikaeli, waBaaseya, waMalikhiya,
waEtsini, waZera, waAdaya,
waEtsani, waZima, waShimei,
waYahatsi, waGerishomu, waLawi.
Ne khumukhono mukhasi balikhwo abaana babwe, abaana baMerari; mbu Etsani waKishi, waAbudi, waMalukhu,
waHashabia, waAmazia, WaHiIikia,
waAmuzi, waBani, waShemeri,
waMali, waMushi, waMerari, waLawi.
Nabaana babwe abaLawi bareebwaho khulwa obukhalabani bwosi bweshimenyo shieinzu yaNyasaye.
Tsinzibulo tsiaHaruni

Naye Haruni nabaanabe bali nibamalilanga emisango khushimalilo shiemisango emisambe, nokhushimalilo shiamalesi kelibuuliesi, khulwa emilimo chiosi chiahabundu ahashila obutakatifu, nende okhutisa Isiraeli, kosi aka Musa omusumba waNyasaye yali niyalaka shinga olwa kali.
Ne abaana baHaruni mbabano; mbu Eleazari omwanawe; Finehasi u aEleazari; Abishua waFinehasi;
Buki waAbishua; Uzi waBuki; Zerahia waUzi;
Merayotsi waZerahia; Amaria waMerayotsi; Ahitubu waAmaria;
Zadoki waAhitubu; Ahimaazi waZadoki.
Amataala kabaLawi
Ne bino nibio ebimenyo biabwe, tsikambi tsiabwe etsiomunzakho; siabwe shinga olwa tsiali; mbu khubaana baHaruni, abetsinzu tsiabakohatsi, okhuba ikha yabakwila,
babaheelesia Heberoni mushialo shiaYuda, nobwayilo bwalio obwalibotokhana;
nebutswa emikunda chielitaala elo, nebisoma bialio, bamuheelesia Kalebu waYefune.
Baheelesia abaana baHaruni amataala kobwilushilo tsana, mbu Heberoni, Libina nobwayilo bwalio, Yatiri, Eshetemoa nobwayilo bwalio,
Hileni nobwayilo bwalio, Debiri nobwayilo bwalio,
Ashani nobwayilo bwalio, naBetsi-shemeshi nobwayilo bwalio;
nokhurula khuluyia lwaBenyamini, Geba nobwayilo bwalio, Alemetsi nobwayilo bwalio, naAnatsotsi nobwayilo bwalio. Amataala kabwe kosi, mubetsinzu tsiabwe tsiosi, kali amataala ekhumi nakataru.
Nabandi abatong'a khubaana baKohatsi bakabilwakhwo emikabo echirulila mukha, khubeinzu eyomuluyia olwo, mbu inusu yoluyia lwaManase, amataala ekhumi.

Ne khubaana baGerishomu, tsinzu tsiabwe shinga olwa tsiali, okhurula khuluyia lwaIsakhari, nokhurula khuluyia lwaAsheri, nokhurula khuluyia lwaNafutali, nokhurula khuluyia lwaManase eBashani, amataala ekhumi nakataru.
Khubaana baMerari, tsinzu tsiabwe shinga olwa tsiali, bakabilwa mukha okhurula khuluyia lwaReubeni, nokhurula khuluyia lwaGadi, nokhurula khuluyia lwaZabuloni, amataala ekhumi nakabili.
Nilwo olwa abaana baIsiraeli bakabila abaLawi amataala halala nobwayilo bwako.
Nibakabila bario mukha okhurula khuluyia lwaYuda, nokhurula khuluyia lwaSimeoni, nokhurula khuluyia lwaBenyamini, amataala ako aka ameera kako kakharalwa.
Ne etsindi khutinzu tsiabaana baKohatsi tsiali namataala akomumbali tsiabwe, akarula muluyia lwaEfuraimu.
Nibabaheelesia ama-taala kobwilushilo, mbu Shekhemu mushialo shiebikulu shieEfuraimu nobwayilo bwalio; nende Gezeri nobwayilo bwalio;
naYokemeamu nobwayilo bwalio, naBetsi-horoni nobwayilo bwalio;
naAiyaloni nobwayilo bwalio, naGatsirimoni nobwayilo bwalio;
nokhurula khunusu yoluyia lwaManase, Aneri nobwayilo bwalio, naBileamu nobwayilo bwalio, khulwabo abatong'a khubeinzu yabaana baKohatsi.
Khubaana baGerishomu, bakabilwa, okhurula khubeinzu yeinusu yoluyia lwaManase, Golani eBashani nobwayilo bwalio, naAshitarotsi nobwayilo bwalio.
Nokhurula khuluyia lwaIsakhari, Kedeshi nobwayilo bwalio, Daberatsi nobwayilo bwalio,
Ramotsi nobwayilo bwalio, naAnemu nobwayilo bwalio.
Nokhurula khuluyia lwaAsheri, Mashali nobwayilo bwalio, Abudoni nobwayilo bwalio,
Hukoki nobwayilo bwalio, naRehobu nobwayilo bwalio.
Nokhurula khuluyia lwaNafutali, Kedeshi eGalilaya nobwayilo bwalio, Hamoni nobwayilo bwalio, naKiriatsaimu nobwayilo bwalio.
Ne khubandi abatong'a khubaMerari, bakabilwa, okhurula khuluyia lwaZabuloni, Rimono nobwayilo bwalio, naTabori nobwayilo bwalio;
khandi injelekha waYorodani, elubeka Iwebukwe lwaYorodani, bakabilwa, okhurula khuluyia lwaReubeni, Bezeri mushitsiimi nobwayilo bwalio, Yaza nobwayilo bwalio,
Kedemotsi nobwayilo bwalio, naMefaatsi nobwayilo bwalio.
Nokhurula khuluyia lwaGadi, Ramotsi eGileadi nobwayilo bwalio, Mahanaimu nobwayilo bwalio,
Heshiboni nobwayilo bwalio, naYazeri nobwayilo bwalio.
